question: Is a dedicated northbound lane worth running?
scope: Supplied rate history and two public rate references. Fuel not modelled.

claims.statement: The recorded floor for this lane is 2.35 per mile.
Twelve-week average on this lane was 2.48 per mile.

claims.topic: volume is steady enough to dedicate
claims.statement: Loads were available in 11 of the last 12 weeks.

claims.topic: volume is steady enough to dedicate
claims.statement: Corridor volume declined 9 percent quarter over quarter.
Typical repositioning on this corridor is under 60 miles.

recommendation.statement: Worth running as a trial rather than a dedicated commitment. Consider four weeks, then review.
recommendation.rationale: The lane clears the recorded floor on two sources, but volume is contested and rests on a single public index that disagrees with our own records.
open_questions: Does the public index cover the same corridor segment as our load records?
What does fuel do to the 2.48 average? Fuel was not modelled.
